actions.name: Occurs in at least one protected area

documentation.range: This species is known only from two collections made in 1932 and 1935, within the same locality in the Uluguru Mountains, Lukwangule Plateau.
documentation.population: The population and trend of this species is unknown. However, it is presumably very small, and may even be extinct.
documentation.habitats: This species is presumably found growing on rocky areas in grassland, within deep shade and near streams.
documentation.threats: There are no known major threats to this species.
documentation.measures: This species is found in Uluguru South Forest Reserve. It is not known from ex situ collections (BGCI 2018).
documentation.use_trade: There is no information about use or trade of this species.
documentation.rationale: This herb species is endemic to Tanzania. It is known only from a single location, and has not been collected again for 70 years, despite fairly intense collections in the area. The population is presumed to be very small (fewer than 50 mature individuals) and may even be extinct. There are no known major threats to this species. This species is found in Uluguru South Forest Reserve but is not known from ex situ collections (BGCI 2018). It is here assessed as Critically Endangered.

description.en: Rocky areas (eg. inland cliffs, mountain peaks)
